proposals.sentence: The GMC accepts OET on paper, OET on computer and OET@Home.
proposals.quotation: We can accept the following versions of OET: OET on paper OET on computer OET@Home

proposals.sentence: A Pathways applicant who misses the score in one sub-test must retake all four sub-tests.
proposals.quotation: must retake all OET Medicine sub-tests (Listening, Reading, Writing, and Speaking)

proposals.sentence: There is no limit on the number of times OET Medicine can be retaken.
proposals.quotation: There is no limit on the number of times you can retake OET Medicine

proposals.sentence: The Medical Council of New Zealand asks doctors for at least 350 in Speaking, Listening and Reading and 300 in Writing in the OET Medicine.
proposals.quotation: Minimum required scores: Speaking 350 Listening 350 Reading 350 Writing 300

proposals.sentence: The Optometrists and Dispensing Opticians Board asks for at least a B pass (or a score of 350) in each of the four OET components.
proposals.quotation: A minimum B pass (or a score of 350)

proposals.sentence: The board's minimum applies to each of the four OET components.
proposals.quotation: each of the four components (listening, reading, writing, and speaking)

proposals.sentence: The Veterinary Council of New Zealand asks for grade A or B in each of the four OET sub-tests, all from one sitting.
proposals.quotation: Applicants need to achieve a pass with A or B grades in each of the 4 sections at 1 sitting.

proposals.sentence: Australia's National Boards accept the OET only on paper or on computer at a test centre.
proposals.quotation: OET - Occupational English Test (on paper or computer based in testing centre)

proposals.sentence: They do not accept at-home or remotely proctored versions of English tests.
proposals.quotation: Any at home and/or 'indicative' versions of any of the English language tests or versions that include any element of remote proctoring, except the OET computer-based test (at test centre only), are not approved by National Boards and are not accepted

proposals.sentence: CORU asks dietitians for grade B (350) in three OET components and C+ (300) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Dietetics) A minimum of Grade B (350) in three components and a minimum of Grade C+ (300) in one component

proposals.sentence: CORU asks physiotherapists for grade B (350) in three OET components and C+ (300) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Physiotherapy) A minimum of Grade B (350) in three components and a minimum of Grade C+ (300) in one component

proposals.sentence: CORU asks occupational therapists for grade B (350) in three OET components and C+ (300) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Occupational Therapy) A minimum of grade B (350) in three components and a minimum of Grade C+ (300) in one component

proposals.sentence: CORU asks optometrists for grade B (350) in three OET components and C+ (300) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Optometry) A minimum of Grade B (350) in three components and a minimum of Grade C+ (300) in one component

proposals.sentence: CORU asks radiographers for at least grade B (350) in all four OET components.
proposals.quotation: OET (Radiography) A minimum of Grade B (Minimum Score of 350) in all components

proposals.sentence: CORU asks podiatrists for grade B in three OET components and C+ (300) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Podiatry) A minimum of Grade B in three components and a minimum Grade C+ (300) in one component

proposals.sentence: CORU asks speech and language therapists for grade B (400) in three OET components and B (350) in one.
proposals.quotation: OET (Speech Pathology) A minimum of Grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one component

proposals.sentence: OET lists the full four-part test at AU$587.
proposals.quotation: costs AU$587 (or US$455 for OET on Computer at a venue and OET@Home in the US)
